Attached: 1 image

The source for the LuaScript API cheatsheet is also available under CC-BY 4.0 now. It's written in HTML+CSS and converted to PDF with #Weasyprint, and the buildscript also creates the alternate greyscale version using some substutions and a different CSS stylesheet.

These sources may be of interest if you want to make your own API reference cheatsheet for something else in a similar style.

https://github.com/principia-game/luascript-cheatsheet
